QuestInfo.name: The Monster of Lion King Castle
QuestInfo.0: You go to Alicia to give her the Thorny Bear and you discover that the Lion King's Castle is on fire! What happened? Go talk to Mylar!
QuestInfo.1: Mylar really needs to focus for the detection spell to work. Help him concentrate by taking care of the Gatekeepers around the Castle Ramparts.
QuestInfo.2: Mylar's spell detected a life form inside the castle. You spoke with him about the potential survivor.
